routes.notes: Field-verified prototype direct service between PSU Mexico frontage and the SM/Robinsons area. Outbound signboard: SM Pampanga. Return boarding is at Robinsons Starmills Arayat Gate on a SAN JUAN jeepney. Direct regular outbound fare is PHP 30; student payment was reported around PHP 25 and is not encoded as an exact discount. Service was reported generally available only until around 4:30 PM and difficult or unavailable from around 4:30 PM onward; no exact timetable is asserted. Vehicles may leave when full, but no ServicePattern is created because operating days and exact schedule are unknown.

Existing Arayat–San Fernando via Sta. Ana/Mexico research route reused for the field-verified prototype Mexico Bayan to SM Pampanga segment. Activation applies only to the modeled segment and does not assert every stop, timetable, fleet, or modern-jeep alternative on the full through-route.
